parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Chilliwack · Fairfield Island
Fairfield Island is an MLS® sub-area name in the City of Chilliwack. The City doesn’t publish a boundary for it.
The City plans Fairfield Island together with Chilliwack Proper, in the Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island Neighbourhoods Plan, and groups it with its central neighbourhoods.

blocks.text: Planning and flood notes for Fairfield Island

parts.t: Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.
The Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island Neighbourhoods Plan covers Fairfield Island together with Chilliwack Proper.
The City’s 2018 Annual Report records that the City adopted and implemented the plan in 2018.
The City’s 2018 CARIP report describes the adoption as implementing the plan as a schedule to the Official Community Plan.

ALR: the City says 67% of Chilliwack’s land (17,322 hectares) is in the Agricultural Land Reserve. The Fraser River valley bottom (14,000 hectares) holds the ALR land the City’s Agricultural Area Plan describes as the best for agriculture.
The City’s Development Permit Area 4, for protecting farming, covers all valley-floor farmland in the ALR and properties over 2 hectares.

Flood: the City says its floodplain maps were updated in 2007 using provincial Fraser River flood levels based on the 1894 flood of record, estimated at about a 1-in-500-year flood. It keeps flood response plans for both the Fraser River and the Vedder River.
The East Dyke and the Young Road dyke have been upgraded under the City’s $30 million dyke-raising program.
The City’s Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 4519 sets the Flood Construction Level plus 0.6 m of freeboard for construction in floodplain areas protected by a standard dike.

blocks.text: Before you buy in Fairfield Island

parts.t: Check the flood rules for the lot.
Fairfield Island is low-lying and dyked. Ask the City how the floodplain bylaw applies to the exact address.
Ask about drainage and the basement.
Ask the seller about past water in the basement or crawl space, and have the inspector look at drainage.
Check the ALR on larger lots.
Look up the address on the Agricultural Land Commission map before you plan anything on farmland.
Confirm the school catchment.
Use the SD33 catchment map for the exact address.
For a strata home, read the documents.
The depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees, plus any special levies.
Get a full home inspection.
Check the roof, furnace, plumbing and wiring.
Where is Fairfield Island?
Fairfield Island is an MLS® sub-area name. The City doesn’t publish a boundary for it.
The City covers it together with Chilliwack Proper in one plan, and groups it with its central neighbourhoods.
Ask me if a specific address is in it.
How do I get around from Fairfield Island?
BC Transit route 53 Fairfield is the route named for this area.
Its timing points are Downtown Chilliwack (Yale Rd), Menzies St at Riverside Dr and Young Rd at Clare Ave, then back to Downtown Chilliwack.
See the
route 53 page
Which schools serve Fairfield Island?
Strathcona Elementary (kindergarten to grade 5) is at 46375 Strathcona Rd. SD33’s catchment map places it in the Clare Avenue area of Fairfield Island.
Chilliwack Middle School (grades 6 to 8) is at 46354 Yale Rd, and Chilliwack Secondary School (grades 9 to 12) is at 46363 Yale Rd.
Check an exact address with
SD33
What parks are on Fairfield Island?
Fairfield Park is at 46219 Clare Avenue and has a dog off-leash area.
Gwynne Vaughan Park is a City park on the island.
Island 22 Regional Park, at 44955 Cartmell Road, is a 132-hectare Fraser River park run by the Fraser Valley Regional District.
What plan covers Fairfield Island?
The Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island Neighbourhoods Plan. The City’s 2018 Annual Report records that it adopted and implemented the plan in 2018.
Is Fairfield Island in a floodplain?

Fairfield Island is low-lying Fraser River valley-floor land protected by the City’s dyke system. The City has an ongoing $30 million program to raise the dykes to current provincial flood levels, and the East Dyke and the Young Road dyke have been upgraded.
The Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 4519 sets the Flood Construction Level plus 0.6 m of freeboard for construction in floodplain areas protected by a standard dike.
Ask me or the City about a specific lot.
Is any of Fairfield Island in the ALR, and what are the lots like?
ALR status is set parcel by parcel, so check the exact address on the
Agricultural Land Commission map
. City-wide, 67% of Chilliwack’s land is in the ALR.
Lot size (FVREB MLS® recorded sales data): the median lot size of detached houses sold in recent 2026 MLS® activity was 7,492 sq ft, based on 7 sales with a recorded lot size.
